findings.reason: The one-attempt limit and inherited timeout lack evidence establishing why those exact boundaries are necessary; a transient connection failure followed by a successful retry is a legitimate counterexample that bounded intelligent retry judgment could accommodate.

When trace generation discovers findings after independent review, the required reassessment depends on the builder remembering to re-engage the reviewer and refresh the trace, without an architectural mechanism ensuring that reassessment occurs.

fit.reason: The design directly implements the all-fixes review obligation by closing tier bypasses and requiring the existing side-effects reviewer to assess each change and advisory findings while preserving review authority and documenting interactions and rollback.
